rule: Guild specialists support product and building champions. They do not own a second roadmap or replace the champion.

conflict_rules: An image producer cannot judge or approve the same candidate.
A clip producer or motion director cannot be the motion-quality judge for the same clip.
A product champion cannot be the neutral evaluator in its own championship.
A social creative producer cannot supply missing owner approval or authorize publication.
An implementer cannot be the sole release verifier.
Revenue cannot override product quality, accuracy/safety/trust or positive LAiDIES brand contribution.

competition_roles.purpose: strongest evidence-based improvement to the current product
second distinct route, not a paraphrase
disprove logic, evidence, safety, UX, plumbing, brand and maintainability claims
score anonymized candidates against the shared non-compensable quality floor
